newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN MKT CAP AT NEW HIGH, 1997 TURNOVER JUMPS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN MKT CAP AT NEW HIGH, 1997 TURNOVER JUMPS.

text.p: The market capitalisation of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange climbed to a new record high of 1.241 trillion rand at the close of business on Thursday, up from 1.130 trillion at the end of December 1996.
At the same time, the JSE said turnover on the market, excluding arbitrage deals, rose by 57.6 percent in the first five months of 1997 compared to the same period last year.
The JSE said trade worth 73.274 billion rand had been concluded from the start of the year to May 30, compared with 46.497 billion rand in the same 1996 period.
Net foreign purchases in the first five months of 1997 were 8.972 billion rand compared to 5.254 billion in the whole of 1996.
